Plot fitted MFRM results with ggplot2

Source: R/api-plotting-fit-family.R, R/help_visual_diagnostics.R
plot.mfrm_fit.Rd

Render a Wright map, pathway map, category probability curves (CCC), or consolidated diagnostic/comparison view from a fitted fit_mfrm() object. Invisibly returns a ggplot object carrying underlying tables and notes via plot_data() and plot_data_components().

Usage 

# S3 method for class 'mfrm_fit'
plot(
  x,
  type = NULL,
  facet = NULL,
  top_n = 30,
  theta_range = c(-6, 6),
  theta_points = 241,
  title = NULL,
  palette = NULL,
  label_angle = 45,
  show_ci = NULL,
  ci_level = 0.95,
  group = NULL,
  diagnostics = NULL,
  include_fit_measures = TRUE,
  fit_stat = c("Infit", "Outfit"),
  fit_scale = c("mnsq", "zstd"),
  zstd_method = c("facets", "engine"),
  include_person = FALSE,
  person_subset = NULL,
  top_n_person = 30,
  person_labels = c("flagged", "all", "none"),
  facet_labels = c("all", "flagged", "none"),
  panel = c("combined", "facet"),
  fit_range = c(0.5, 1.5),
  zstd_cut = 2,
  draw = TRUE,
  preset = c("standard", "publication", "compact", "monochrome"),
  renderer = NULL,
  wright_style = c("native", "facets_style"),
  category_labels = NULL,
  rows_per_logit = 2L,
  wright_range = NULL,
  extreme_placement = c("ends", "estimate"),
  persons_per_star = NULL,
  show_title = FALSE,
  show_notes = FALSE,
  marginal = c("auto", "histogram", "none"),
  ...,
  level = NULL,
  view = NULL,
  metric = NULL,
  comparison = NULL,
  labels = NULL,
  highlight = NULL
)

Arguments

x

An mfrm_fit object from fit_mfrm().

type

NULL/"wright" (primary Wright map), "bundle"/"all"/"default" (Wright + pathway + CCC composite), "facet", "person", "step", "pathway", "fit_pathway", "ccc", "ccc_surface"/"category_surface", "trajectory", or a consolidated diagnostic route ("person_fit", "rater_severity", "thresholds", "reliability", "agreement", "guttman", "residual_matrix", "residual_qq", "residual_pca", "local_dependence", "bubble", "marginal_fit", "marginal_pairwise", "fair_average", "displacement", "unexpected", "facets_chisq", "qc", "facet_dashboard", "facet_equivalence", "bias", "shrinkage", "apa_summary"; corrected JML supports "slopes", "locations", and "steps").

facet

Optional facet name for type = "facet" or location views.

top_n

Maximum non-Person facet levels retained on compact native Wright maps (30 default; Inf keeps all; steps are retained separately) and optional named list (e.g., list(Rater = "R01")) prefixing selected labels with > .

theta_range

Ability grid bounds (c(-6, 6)) and node count for pathway, CCC, and surface views.

theta_points

Ability grid bounds (c(-6, 6)) and node count for pathway, CCC, and surface views.

title

Optional title metadata, palette overrides, and x-axis label angle.

palette

Optional title metadata, palette overrides, and x-axis label angle.

label_angle

Optional title metadata, palette overrides, and x-axis label angle.

show_ci

Display approximate intervals when available (NULL enables CIs on native Wright and fit_pathway views; supply either ci_level or level, default 0.95).

ci_level

Display approximate intervals when available (NULL enables CIs on native Wright and fit_pathway views; supply either ci_level or level, default 0.95).

group

Optional Person grouping column name (in group_data or fit$prep$data) or aligned vector overlaying descriptive Person KDE curves on native Wright maps (density_bw = "nrd0", density_adjust = 1 via ...; >= 5 non-constant included Persons required for a curve; inspect plot_data(p, "group_density")).

diagnostics

Optional matching diagnose_mfrm() object and logical (TRUE default) attaching fit-measure tables to pathway payloads.

include_fit_measures

Optional matching diagnose_mfrm() object and logical (TRUE default) attaching fit-measure tables to pathway payloads.

fit_stat

Controls for type = "fit_pathway": "Infit"/"Outfit", "mnsq"/"zstd", ZSTD df convention ("facets" or "engine"), Person inclusion/subset/ranking, label policies ("flagged", "all", "none"), panel layout ("combined" or "facet"), and heuristic review lines.

Value

Invisibly, a ggplot object carrying locations, notes, display, retention, fit_readiness, interpretation_status, and scale_contract accessible via plot_data().

Details

Scale, conditioning, and display payloads. Higher Person locations raise expected coded scores; under default negative facet orientation, higher non-Person locations indicate greater severity/difficulty (positive_facets reverses sign). Pathway and CCC curves hold non-target additive facets and interactions at zero (curve_basis). Boundary-clipped coordinates record OriginalEstimate separately from DisplayEstimate, and blocked-fit extreme MML EAPs are recorded in person_exclusions.

Visual diagnostics map, presets, and missing-interval states

Question Primary plot() route
Shared logit targeting of Persons, facets, and steps plot(fit, type = "wright")
Expected scores and category probability curves plot(fit, type = "pathway") or type = "ccc"
Model-fit overview and response screens plot(fit, type = "qc"), "unexpected", "displacement", "marginal_fit"
Inter-rater score agreement vs residual structure plot(fit, type = "agreement"), "residual_pca", "local_dependence", "bias"
Connectedness, anchor drift, or group DFF plot(result) on subset_connectivity_report(), detect_anchor_drift(), or analyze_dff()

Session defaults and editing. Set options(mfrmr.plot_preset = "publication") ("standard", "publication", "compact", or "monochrome") for a session preset; explicit preset overrides the option and preset = NULL uses "standard". Every plot() method returns a ggplot invisibly (draw = FALSE suppresses device drawing). Titles and explanatory notes stay outside the canvas by default (show_title = FALSE, show_notes = FALSE) and remain accessible via plot_data(p, "title") and plot_data(p, "notes").

Missing estimates and intervals. Retain rows with NA bounds alongside their Status, CIEligible, CoverageQualified, and InferenceReview fields: fixed marks constraint-pinned coordinates, prior_only marks Persons without observed responses, and CoverageQualified = FALSE records unestablished finite-sample nominal coverage rather than numerical failure. See vignette("mfrmr-visual-diagnostics", package = "mfrmr").

See also

fit_mfrm(), diagnose_mfrm(), plot_data(), as_ggplot()

Examples 

library(mfrmr)

# Saved synthetic MML/RSM analysis of example_operational.
# For your own data, fit a model first; see ?fit_mfrm.
example_fit <- readRDS(system.file("examples", "operational-mml.rds", package = "mfrmr"))
fit <- example_fit$fit

# Run each plot command separately to inspect its figure
plot(fit) # Wright map: persons, facets, and category thresholds


# Rater severity estimates (higher means more severe in this example)
plot(fit, type = "facet", facet = "Rater")


# Probability of each score category across the ability scale
plot(fit, type = "ccc")


# Optional: get plot without printing and inspect underlying tables
wright <- plot(fit, draw = FALSE)
head(plot_data(wright, "locations"))
#> # A tibble: 6 × 39
#>   Group Label PlotType    Estimate    SE Fixed CI_Level SE_Method  PrecisionTier
#>   <fct> <chr> <chr>          <dbl> <dbl> <lgl>    <dbl> <chr>      <chr>        
#> 1 Rater R01   Facet level   -0.606 0.181 FALSE     0.95 Observati… exploratory  
#> 2 Rater R02   Facet level   -0.382 0.166 FALSE     0.95 Observati… exploratory  
#> 3 Rater R04   Facet level    0.180 0.185 FALSE     0.95 Observati… exploratory  
#> 4 Rater R05   Facet level    0.184 0.199 FALSE     0.95 Observati… exploratory  
#> 5 Rater R03   Facet level    0.212 0.179 FALSE     0.95 Observati… exploratory  
#> 6 Rater R06   Facet level    0.412 0.219 FALSE     0.95 Observati… exploratory  
#> # ℹ 30 more variables: SupportsFormalInference <lgl>, SEUse <chr>,
#> #   CIBasis <chr>, CIUse <chr>, CIEligible <lgl>, CILabel <chr>,
#> #   Measure_Source <chr>, CI_Lower <dbl>, CI_Upper <dbl>, Step <chr>,
#> #   StepIndex <int>, BoundarySeparated <lgl>, Highlighted <lgl>, XBase <dbl>,
#> #   X <dbl>, OriginalEstimate <dbl>, BelowRange <lgl>, AboveRange <lgl>,
#> #   DisplayEstimate <dbl>, DisplayLabel <chr>, OriginalCI_Lower <dbl>,
#> #   OriginalCI_Upper <dbl>, DisplayCI_Lower <dbl>, DisplayCI_Upper <dbl>, …
# Find a named judge without refitting or dropping the surrounding scale
judge <- subset(plot_data(wright, "locations"), Group == "Rater")$Label[1]
focused <- plot(fit, highlight = list(Rater = judge), draw = FALSE)
subset(plot_data(focused, "locations"), Highlighted)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 39
#>   Group Label PlotType    Estimate    SE Fixed CI_Level SE_Method  PrecisionTier
#>   <fct> <chr> <chr>          <dbl> <dbl> <lgl>    <dbl> <chr>      <chr>        
#> 1 Rater R01   Facet level   -0.606 0.181 FALSE     0.95 Observati… exploratory  
#> # ℹ 30 more variables: SupportsFormalInference <lgl>, SEUse <chr>,
#> #   CIBasis <chr>, CIUse <chr>, CIEligible <lgl>, CILabel <chr>,
#> #   Measure_Source <chr>, CI_Lower <dbl>, CI_Upper <dbl>, Step <chr>,
#> #   StepIndex <int>, BoundarySeparated <lgl>, Highlighted <lgl>, XBase <dbl>,
#> #   X <dbl>, OriginalEstimate <dbl>, BelowRange <lgl>, AboveRange <lgl>,
#> #   DisplayEstimate <dbl>, DisplayLabel <chr>, OriginalCI_Lower <dbl>,
#> #   OriginalCI_Upper <dbl>, DisplayCI_Lower <dbl>, DisplayCI_Upper <dbl>, …

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Requires your own file with Person IDs matching the fitted data.
groups <- read.csv("person-groups.csv") # columns: Person, Cohort
grouped <- plot(fit, group = "Cohort", group_data = groups, draw = FALSE)
plot_data(grouped, "group_density")$summary
# Sensitivity to smoothing, keeping the fitted model unchanged:
plot(fit, group = "Cohort", group_data = groups, density_adjust = 1.5)
} # }
